Last Saturday, Mia and David went to the shopping mall. Mia thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. Mia hopes to visit Xi'an one day. In fact, the bakery is famous for flaky pastry.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the shopping mall by bike. Mia bought a dress at the shop yesterday. Both of them like soup and milk. He bought a ring for his fiancee last week.
Mia likes snowy days best. David is interested in reading. The shopping mall is one of the best places in the city. In fact, lavender grows along the path to the door.
Life is full of small surprises. Mia learned a lot about English. Mia spent the weekend at the bookstore.
